classifications.rationale: The President supplies an authority and purpose recital followed by a section heading, but this segment directs no actor and itself creates no legal consequence.
classifications.evidence: in order to encourage the recognition of volunteer service and civic participation by all Americans

classifications.rationale: The President immediately establishes and structures an internal executive advisory council, including its membership and terms; the effect is executive organization rather than a change in public legal rights.
classifications.evidence: There is hereby established within the Corporation for National and Community Services (CNCS) the President's Council on Service and Civic Participation

classifications.rationale: The President is assigned the mandatory internal-management task of designating the Council's Chair and Vice Chair when its leadership is selected; no external legal consequence is prescribed.
classifications.evidence: The President shall designate one member to serve as Chair and one member to serve as Vice Chair.

classifications.rationale: The Council, federal agencies, CNCS leadership, and designated officers receive administrative, advisory, staffing, support, delegation, and sunset directions; these operate immediately or during Council administration without dictating a later public legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: The Chief Executive Officer of the CNCS shall appoint an Executive Director to head the staff of the Council.
